items.query: select itemcode, itemname, groupcode, subgroup, brand, company, DIVISION, HSNCODE, IGST, commonunit, Cprice, RPrice, Sprice, suppcode, MODIDATE from dbo.STOCKMST001 where itemname is not null and isnull(BLOCK,0) = 0
items.name: itemname

suppliers.query: select CODE, HEAD, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, PHONE1, MOBILE, E_MAIL, GstNO, CRDAYS from dbo.ACCOUNTS001 where GROUPCODE = '170007' and isnull(BLOCK,0) = 0 and HEAD is not null
suppliers.name: HEAD
